methods.name: create
methods.summary: Create a new preview health check.
methods.description: Create a new preview health check.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier

props.name: address
props.description:
The hostname or IP address of the origin server to run health checks
on.

props.name: name
props.description:
A short name to identify the health check. Only alphanumeric
characters, hyphens and underscores are allowed.

props.name: check_regions
props.description:
A list of regions from which to run health checks. Null means
Cloudflare will pick a default region.

props.name: consecutive_fails
props.description:
The number of consecutive fails required from a health check before
changing the health to unhealthy.

props.name: consecutive_successes
props.description:
The number of consecutive successes required from a health check
before changing the health to healthy.

props.name: description
props.description: A human-readable description of the health check.

props.name: http_config
allow_insecure
props.description: Do not validate the certificate when the health check uses HTTPS.

props.name: expected_body
props.description:
A case-insensitive sub-string to look for in the response body. If this string
is not found, the origin will be marked as unhealthy.

props.name: expected_codes
props.description:
The expected HTTP response codes (e.g. "200") or code ranges (e.g. "2xx" for all
codes starting with 2) of the health check.

props.name: follow_redirects
props.description: Follow redirects if the origin returns a 3xx status code.

props.name: header
props.description:
The HTTP request headers to send in the health check. It is recommended you set
a Host header by default. The User-Agent header cannot be overridden.

props.name: method
props.description: The HTTP method to use for the health check.

props.name: path
props.description: The endpoint path to health check against.

props.name: port
props.description:
Port number to connect to for the health check. Defaults to 80 if type is HTTP
or 443 if type is HTTPS.
Parameters specific to an HTTP or HTTPS health check.

props.name: interval
props.description:
The interval between each health check. Shorter intervals may give
quicker notifications if the origin status changes, but will increase load on
the origin as we check from multiple locations.

props.name: retries
props.description:
The number of retries to attempt in case of a timeout before marking
the origin as unhealthy. Retries are attempted immediately.

props.name: suspended
props.description: If suspended, no health checks are sent to the origin.

props.name: tcp_config
method
props.description: The TCP connection method to use for the health check.

props.name: port
props.description: Port number to connect to for the health check. Defaults to 80.
Parameters specific to TCP health check.

props.name: timeout
props.description: The timeout (in seconds) before marking the health check as failed.

props.name: type
props.description:
The protocol to use for the health check. Currently supported
protocols are 'HTTP', 'HTTPS' and 'TCP'.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier
